# Current Database

The current database is hard-coded as MD2DF.R4.

```{r}
knitr::kable( MD2DF[, .( Runs = .N, KSteps = sum( total.steps), 
                            MinT = min(ke.mean.rs), MaxT = max( ke.mean.rs),
                            DiffRuns = sum( !is.na(nrd))), 
                       by = series],
              format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) %>%
  kable_styling( font_size = 15, full_width = F, position = "left",
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```


# Inputs and Outputs

You can embed Shiny inputs and outputs in your document. Outputs are automatically updated whenever inputs change. This demonstrates how a standard R plot can be made interactive:

```{r}
#| context: UI
selectInput( "Series", "Select series below:", unique(MD2DF$series))
plotOutput( "plot")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$plot <- renderPlot( {
   df <- reactive( MD2DF[ series == input$Series,])
   MD2RP::plotconfMD2( df(), y = "Pressure", xlab = "T")
   })


```
